mutations.old: return _State(dict(self.chosen), {name: list(found) for name, found in self.requirements.items()})

alternative_fix_sites: trellis/resolver.py::Resolver._add_dependencies (build a new list instead of appending in place, e.g. state.requirements[dep] = state.requirements.get(dep, []) + [...])
notes: The search state is copied shallowly, so requirement lists are shared between a state and the attempts made from it. When an abandoned candidate added a requirement on a package that already had requirements, that requirement stays behind: later candidates see it, the resolver settles for older versions or reports a false conflict that blames a release it did not choose. Needs backtracking past a release whose dependency hits an already-required package; backtracking that only adds new packages is unaffected (public test).
